product.title: Paul Mitchell Super Skinny Serum
product.body_html:
A best-selling smoothing serum that helps speed up blow-drying and delivers silky, frizz-free results. Super Skinny Serum provides heat protection up to 450°F (230°C) while reducing drying time for faster styling.

The humidity-resistant formula with lightweight silicones smooths the hair cuticle, reduces frizz, and leaves hair sleek, shiny, and manageable in any weather.

Hair Type: 

  • All hair types, including fine hair

Benefits:

  • Speeds up drying time
  • Provides heat protection up to 450°F (230°C)
  • Smooths and controls frizz
  • Leaves hair silky and shiny
  • Lightweight, non-greasy formula

How to Use:

Highly concentrated—use sparingly. Rub one pump into hands and apply to clean, damp hair. Style as desired.

Ingredients:

Lightweight silicones in Super Skinny Serum help smooth hair, seal the cuticle and resist humidity, while the Super Skinny Complex helps reduce drying time for silky, shiny, frizz-free results.
